projects.title: Marketing Command Center
projects.description: Coordinates specialized agents across research, strategy, content, SEO, campaigns, and reporting. A central entry point routes marketing requests through the connected workflows.

projects.title: Market Intelligence Agent
projects.description: Combines news and social research with AI analysis for competitor insights, customer understanding, trend detection, and opportunity identification. Packages the findings into an HTML report.

projects.title: Strategic Planning Agent
projects.description: Brings market intelligence, advertising insights, and previous learnings into a planning agent that produces a structured strategy and presentation.

projects.title: Content Creation Agent
projects.description: Turns a content brief into structured copy, with an optional visual-generation branch and a packaged output for download or use by the orchestrator.

projects.title: Campaign Automation Workflow
projects.description: Connects campaign setup with advertising and email branches, conditional routing, and approval steps to coordinate campaign actions across tools.

projects.title: SEO Audit Agent
projects.description: Collects page HTML, robots.txt, sitemap data, and mobile PageSpeed insights. Adds optional keyword research and assembles the findings into an AI-assisted SEO report.

projects.title: Lead Nurturing Agent
projects.description: Scores and segments incoming leads, routes personalized WhatsApp or email outreach, and connects CRM updates with timed email follow-ups and manual review.

projects.title: Social Media Agent
projects.description: Connects draft generation and approval with social publishing, comment collection, and an approval flow for AI-assisted replies.

projects.title: Marketing Performance Agent
projects.description: Combines analytics, advertising, and CRM inputs in a scheduled workflow to compute KPIs, email an AI-assisted performance report, and feed learnings back into planning.
